Kana tables come from anzzstuff/kanaquiz (MIT, archived):

  https://github.com/anzzstuff/kanaquiz
  commit  f7e46fdc78fd34aef2cbb7d3c69907c4b9adf2db
          (master, 2026-04-14)
  license MIT (COPYING-kanaquiz.txt)  Copyright (c) 2016 Antti Pilto

vendor/kana.js is src/data/kanaDictionary.js transcribed to a classic
script (the GifOS runtime drops type=module). Do not "improve" the
mappings — し is shi, the 46 basic hiragana are the gojūon, dakuten and
yōon sit in the original groups.

NOT copied:
  src/components/*     — React UI; rewritten for GifOS
  src/src-sw.js        — service worker / PWA
  webpack, Babel, Bootstrap from a CDN

The notice COPYING-kanaquiz.txt is packed inside the GIF as well as sitting
here.
